title: Strict full-cascade Linux replay on the integrated branch vs historical Mac baseline
environment: Linux Ubuntu, Node 20.18.1, pnpm 9.15.9, ffmpeg 4.4.2 (LINUX-CPU; no Apple Vision pose, no Mac)

whatWasRun.measuredOutcome: harness executed cleanly (exit 0) but found n=0 gold target events: every stage 0/0 unconditional and conditional, strict survival 0/0, usable 0/0, silent-failure 0/0. No per-stage delta vs baseline is computable from this run.

historicalBaseline.note: matches the program baseline exactly (target 5/5, event 3/5, paddle 5/5, ball 5/5, contact 2/5, phase 4/5, stroke 3/5 unconditional; strict 2/5; usable 2/5). Per HANDOFF_V4_DRAFT and d06 scope notes this is a recorded Mac cascade, not a Linux measurement.

perStageDeltas: NOT COMPUTABLE — the Linux replay processed 0 of 5 gold cases (see forensics). Reporting 0/0 as a regression from 5/5 would be dishonest; the correct reading is that the cascade's INPUT ARTIFACTS do not exist on this host, so the integrated branch's cascade behavior on the gold cases is unmeasured here.

regressionForensics.rootCause: cascadeWaterfall.ts reads runs/<case>/report.json per bench case (datasets/paddle-bench/paddle-bench.json) and skips any case whose report is missing. datasets/paddle-bench/runs/ is gitignored (.gitignore line 17) and has never been committed (git log --all -- datasets/paddle-bench/runs is empty), so all 5 canonical run dirs exist only on the original Mac.

perCase.note: held-out; existence check only, contents never viewed
no clip.mp4 in bundles either — video unrecoverable on this host
held-out; existence check only, contents never viewed

whyNotRegenerable: pnpm lab:regen --exec requires runs/<case>/report.json + people.json to derive the tap manifest, and the manifest's video/outDir paths are absolute Mac paths (/Users/raunakgengiti/...) — inputs absent on Linux.

Pose extraction (people.json) is Apple Vision / macOS-only (documented in d4-01 measurementBoundary, d2-09 DATA_CARD, d3-02 environment) — the TARGET stage and everything downstream cannot be produced on Linux CPU.
Videos: only 3/5 bundle clips are committed (wm-dink-01, wm-volley-02, afn-sasebo-rally1); afn-sasebo-rally2 and afn-vic-rally1 clips are absent.
2/5 cases (wm-dink-01, afn-vic-rally1) are held-out and UNTOUCHABLE — regeneration would violate the program rules even on a Mac from this workstream.
regressionForensics.regressionVerdict: PROVEN EXTERNAL BLOCKER, not a code regression: the integrated branch's cascade harness itself runs cleanly and its stage criteria are unchanged (read-only review of cascadeWaterfall.ts vs the criteria recorded in the baseline artifact: same STAGES, thresholds 0.5 coverage / 50% overlap / 0.3 paddle coverage / 66ms contact / L1-side stroke, same usable-result-v1 and silent-failure-v1.1 contracts).

honestyNotes: The n=0 Linux run artifact datasets/cascade/cascade-1787996827490.json is committed as evidence of the attempt; it is a Linux harness execution, NOT a canonical pose-cascade measurement, and must never be compared numerically against Mac runs.
datasets/cascade/DATA_CARD.md (d2-09-owned) counts 10 cascade files; it now undercounts by 1 — not updated from this workstream (append-only boundary), flagged for the integrator.
Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were not viewed, labeled, tuned against, or regenerated; only file-existence checks were performed.
No production code, docs, migrations, or runs/ artifacts were modified.
unblockPath: Re-run pnpm lab:cascade on the canonical Mac (with datasets/paddle-bench/runs/ present) at the integrated-branch commit, or commit sanitized canonical run artifacts (report.json + people.json) for the 3 non-held-out cases so a Linux replay becomes possible.
